reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from July to August 2026 and remain elevated into September (E-03), most plausibly driven by a billing import validation rule change around August producing a calculation defect that makes bills wrong even for accounts with an accepted ACTUAL meter read (59% of disputed bills, E-04) — not by slower dispute-ticket handling (within SLA, E-02) and not by a tariff change (ruled out, E-07).
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from July to August 2026 and remain elevated into September (E-03). At least the ESTIMATED-read portion of that surge is driven by billing-import validation rule BV-17, deployed 2026-08-01 with no unit scaling on its high-consumption check (E-13), which rejects valid, on-time AMI reads at import and forces estimate substitution, accounting for 1184 of the 1240 ESTIMATED-read disputed bills (E-12, E-04); the mechanism behind the remaining 1785 ACTUAL-read disputed bills (59% of 3025) is not yet established by evidence.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
